import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_threshold = 0.6
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    
    # Identify near-duplicates to remove
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= corr_threshold:
                to_remove.add(ids[j])
    
    # Filter features
    filtered_ids = [fid for fid in ids if fid not in to_remove]
    if not filtered_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Get indices of remaining features
    filtered_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in filtered_ids]
    x_filtered = x[:, filtered_indices]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (mean difference by outcome)
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(filtered_ids):
        y1_mean = np.mean(x_filtered[y==1, i])
        y0_mean = np.mean(x_filtered[y==0, i])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(y1_mean - y0_mean))
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    top_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    selected_ids = [filtered_ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Check if any features selected
    if not selected_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build logistic regression features
    columns = selected_ids.copy()
    products = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Add interaction terms for top features
    for i in range(len(selected_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(selected_ids)):
            if selected_ids[i] < selected_ids[j]:  # Avoid duplicates
                products.append((selected_ids[i], selected_ids[j]))
    
    # Create weighted score from top features
    for i, fid in enumerate(selected_ids):
        loadings[fid] = effect_sizes[top_indices[i]]
    
    # Limit drivers to at most 4 as per checker report
    drivers = tuple(selected_ids[:4])
    
    # Return design
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
